content.short: Since 2013, CEX.IO has offered spot, margin and staking on 200+ assets to customers in more than 100 countries.
content.description: CEX.IO has been running since 2013. Customers can fund accounts by bank transfer, card or crypto, then trade spot pairs, open margin positions or stake supported assets. It lists more than 200 tokens across the major networks, and its on and off-ramps serve users in over 100 countries. UK customers use a separate entity with its own terms. The company is registered in the United Kingdom.
content.meta: Long-running exchange for buying, trading and staking 200+ assets with card and bank deposits. Explore CEX.IO on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: CEX.IO Resumes UK Operations, Backs Stricter Crypto Rules
resources.tldr: After a voluntary pause, CEX.IO returns to the UK under the FCA's new rules for crypto promotions.
